# Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `RELGAP_CONFIG` | Config file to read instead of the discovered project file, as --config does. |
| `RELGAP_<KEY>` | Sets a config key; the [configuration](/reference/config) page names the variable of each key. An unknown `RELGAP_` variable is ignored with a warning. |
| `GH_TOKEN` | GitHub token, tried first. Without a token relgap reads gh's config file, then runs gh auth token, and otherwise sends unauthenticated requests (60 per hour). |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub token, tried when GH\_TOKEN is not set. |
| `BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN` | Bitbucket Cloud API token or access token, sent as Bearer to api.bitbucket.org only. Without it relgap sends anonymous requests (60 per hour per IP). |
| `GITLAB_TOKEN` | GitLab token, sent in PRIVATE-TOKEN only to the host in GITLAB\_HOST (default gitlab.com), unless a gitlab.hosts entry names its own token\_env. |
| `GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN` | GitLab token, tried when GITLAB\_TOKEN is not set. |
| `GITLAB_HOST` | The GitLab host that GITLAB\_TOKEN belongs to; default gitlab.com. |
| `CI_JOB_TOKEN` | GitLab CI job token, sent in JOB-TOKEN only to CI\_SERVER\_HOST, when that host has no other token. |
| `CI_SERVER_HOST` | The GitLab host CI\_JOB\_TOKEN belongs to; GitLab CI sets it. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | API key for --summarize with the anthropic provider when llm.api\_key\_env is empty. |
| `AWS_*` | The AWS SDK reads its usual variables for --summarize with the bedrock provider, such as AWS\_REGION and AWS\_PROFILE. |
| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` | Repository for the github-pr-comment notifier when the config names none. |
| `GITHUB_API_URL` | GitHub API URL for the github-pr-comment notifier when the config names none. |
| `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` | Event file that digest --pull-request and github-pr-comment read the pull request from in GitHub Actions. |
| `HOME` | Home directory: the config and cache directories, the go command's settings file, and mise's data directory for outdated --binaries. |
| `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | Base of the user config file, $XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/relgap/config.yaml, and of the go command's settings file, $XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/go/env, on Linux. |
| `GOPRIVATE` | Go module path patterns that never reach OSV, as the go command keeps them from its proxy and checksum database. Read like the go command does: the variable, else the go env file. |
| `GONOPROXY` | More Go module path patterns that never reach OSV; defaults to GOPRIVATE. |
| `GONOSUMDB` | More Go module path patterns that never reach OSV; defaults to GOPRIVATE. |
| `GOENV` | The go command's settings file that GOPRIVATE, GONOPROXY and GONOSUMDB are read from when the variables are empty; off reads none. Default: go/env in the user config directory. |
| `APPDATA` | The user config directory on Windows, where the go command's settings file is. |
| `XDG_CACHE_HOME` | Base of the cache directory: $XDG\_CACHE\_HOME/relgap. |
| `XDG_DATA_HOME` | Base of mise's data directory for outdated --binaries when MISE\_DATA\_DIR is not set. |
| `MISE_DATA_DIR` | mise's data directory, whose installs outdated --binaries looks at. |
| `NO_COLOR` | Turns color off with --color auto. |
| `CLICOLOR_FORCE` | Turns color on with --color auto, even when output is not a terminal. |
| `PATH` | Where outdated --binaries looks for installed tools, and where mise, gh and git are looked up. |
| `PATHEXT` | File extensions of programs on Windows, for the same lookup. |

## Child processes

A child process, such as terraform, starts with only these variables from relgap's environment, plus the ones the command sets for it. A `*` matches any suffix.

`PATH`, `HOME`, `USER`, `LOGNAME`, `SHELL`, `TMPDIR`, `TEMP`, `TMP`, `TZ`, `TERM`, `LANG`, `LC_*`, `XDG_*`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY`, `http_proxy`, `https_proxy`, `no_proxy`, `SSL_CERT_FILE`, `SSL_CERT_DIR`, `AWS_*`, `TF_*`, `TG_*`, `TERRAGRUNT_*`, `TOFU_*`, `OPENTOFU_*`, `MISE_*`, `GIT_*`, `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, `SYSTEMROOT`, `SystemRoot`, `COMSPEC`, `PATHEXT`, `WINDIR`, `APPDATA`, `LOCALAPPDATA`, `USERPROFILE`, `PROGRAMDATA`, `ProgramFiles`, `ProgramFiles(x86)`
